sentences.es: ¡Hola! Me llamo Lucía.
sentences.en: Hello! My name is Lucía.

sentences.es: Mi perro se llama Coco.
sentences.en: My dog is called Coco.

sentences.es: Coco es blanco y negro.
sentences.en: Coco is white and black.

sentences.es: Mi mamá se llama Ana y mi papá se llama Juan.
sentences.en: My mum's name is Ana and my dad's name is Juan.

sentences.es: —¡Hola, Lucía! ¿Qué tal? —dice Sol.
sentences.en: "Hello, Lucía! How are you?" says Sol.

sentences.es: —¡Bien, gracias! Estoy feliz —dice Lucía.
sentences.en: "Good, thank you! I'm happy," says Lucía.

sentences.es: En el jardín hay pájaros: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco.
sentences.en: In the garden there are birds: one, two, three, four, five.

sentences.es: Un pájaro es rojo y un pájaro es azul.
sentences.en: One bird is red and one bird is blue.

sentences.es: Por la noche, Lucía dice: —¡Buenas noches, Coco!
sentences.en: At night, Lucía says: "Good night, Coco!"

questions.q: What is Lucía's dog called?
How does Lucía feel?
How many birds are in the garden?

sentences.es: Hoy es sábado y hace sol.
sentences.en: Today is Saturday and it's sunny.

sentences.es: —¡Vamos a la playa! —dice papá.
sentences.en: "Let's go to the beach!" says Dad.

sentences.es: Lucía lleva una camiseta roja y un sombrero.
sentences.en: Lucía is wearing a red T-shirt and a hat.

sentences.es: En la mochila hay agua, pan y queso.
sentences.en: In the backpack there is water, bread and cheese.

sentences.es: El mar es azul y la arena es amarilla.
sentences.en: The sea is blue and the sand is yellow.

sentences.es: Lucía nada en el mar con su hermano.
sentences.en: Lucía swims in the sea with her brother.

sentences.es: Después, comen fresas y sandía. ¡Qué rico!
sentences.en: Afterwards, they eat strawberries and watermelon. How tasty!

sentences.es: El domingo llueve y hace frío.
sentences.en: On Sunday it rains and it's cold.

sentences.es: Lucía está en casa con un libro. ¡Está muy contenta!
sentences.en: Lucía is at home with a book. She's very happy!

questions.q: What day do they go to the beach?
What is Lucía wearing?
opts: A red T-shirt and a hat

questions.q: What is the weather like on Sunday?

sentences.es: Me llamo Marco y tengo ocho años.
sentences.en: My name is Marco and I'm eight years old.

sentences.es: Soy alto y simpático.
sentences.en: I'm tall and friendly.

sentences.es: Me despierto a las siete y desayuno pan con chocolate.
sentences.en: I wake up at seven and I have bread with chocolate for breakfast.

sentences.es: Voy al cole a las nueve.
sentences.en: I go to school at nine.

sentences.es: En el recreo, juego al fútbol con mis amigos.
sentences.en: At break time, I play football with my friends.

sentences.es: No me gusta la sopa, pero me gustan las frutas.
sentences.en: I don't like soup, but I like fruit.

sentences.es: Por la tarde, quiero ir al parque. ¡Puedo correr muy rápido!
sentences.en: In the afternoon, I want to go to the park. I can run really fast!

sentences.es: A las nueve de la noche, me acuesto. ¡Buenas noches!
sentences.en: At nine at night, I go to bed. Good night!

questions.q: How old is Marco?
What does Marco play at break time?
What time does Marco go to bed?

title: Había una vez un dragón
en: Once upon a time there was a dragon

sentences.es: Había una vez un dragón pequeño y verde.
sentences.en: Once upon a time there was a small green dragon.

sentences.es: El dragón se llamaba Pepe.
sentences.en: The dragon was called Pepe.

sentences.es: Un día, Pepe fue a la tienda del pueblo.
sentences.en: One day, Pepe went to the village shop.

sentences.es: —¿Cuánto cuesta el helado? —preguntó.
sentences.en: "How much is the ice cream?" he asked.

sentences.es: —Dos euros —dijo la señora.
sentences.en: "Two euros," said the lady.

sentences.es: Pepe comió el helado muy, muy rápido.
sentences.en: Pepe ate the ice cream very, very fast.

sentences.es: —¡Ay! ¡Me duele la cabeza! —dijo Pepe.
sentences.en: "Ow! My head hurts!" said Pepe.

sentences.es: —Tranquilo, el helado está muy frío —dijo la señora.
sentences.en: "Don't worry, the ice cream is very cold," said the lady.

sentences.es: —Mañana voy a comer el helado despacio —dijo Pepe. Fin.
sentences.en: "Tomorrow I'm going to eat my ice cream slowly," said Pepe. The end.

questions.q: What was the dragon called?
How much was the ice cream?
Why did Pepe's head hurt?
opts: He ate the ice cream too fast

sentences.es: El sábado, Sol y Luna van al supermercado en bicicleta.
sentences.en: On Saturday, Sol and Luna go to the supermarket by bike.

sentences.es: Tienen una lista: tomates, patatas, una lechuga y una botella de leche.
sentences.en: They have a list: tomatoes, potatoes, a lettuce and a bottle of milk.

sentences.es: En el supermercado, Luna coge un carrito.
sentences.en: At the supermarket, Luna takes a trolley.

sentences.es: Sol quiere chocolate, pero no está en la lista.
sentences.en: Sol wants chocolate, but it isn't on the list.

sentences.es: —¡Sol! Primero, las verduras —dice Luna.
sentences.en: "Sol! Vegetables first," says Luna.

sentences.es: Después, van al parque. Sol juega al fútbol y Luna lee un libro.
sentences.en: Afterwards, they go to the park. Sol plays football and Luna reads a book.

sentences.es: Por la tarde, visitan una granja. Hay gallinas, patos y una vaca.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, they visit a farm. There are hens, ducks and a cow.

sentences.es: —¡Qué día tan bonito! —dice Sol.
sentences.en: "What a lovely day!" says Sol.

questions.q: How do Sol and Luna get to the supermarket?
What does Sol want that isn't on the list?
Which animals are on the farm?

sentences.es: Hoy es el cumpleaños de Luna. ¡Hay una fiesta!
sentences.en: Today is Luna's birthday. There's a party!

sentences.es: Hay globos, una tarta y muchos regalos.
sentences.en: There are balloons, a cake and lots of presents.

sentences.es: Su mejor amiga, Estrella, toca la guitarra.
sentences.en: Her best friend, Estrella, plays the guitar.

sentences.es: Sol canta una canción, pero canta muy mal. ¡Todos se ríen!
sentences.en: Sol sings a song, but he sings very badly. Everyone laughs!

sentences.es: —En mi opinión, Sol canta mejor que un gato —dice Estrella.
sentences.en: "In my opinion, Sol sings better than a cat," says Estrella.

sentences.es: Luna sopla las velas. —¡Felicidades! —dicen sus amigos.
sentences.en: Luna blows out the candles. "Happy birthday!" say her friends.

sentences.es: Luna está muy contenta.
sentences.en: Luna is very happy.

sentences.es: —¡Es el mejor cumpleaños del mundo! —dice.
sentences.en: "It's the best birthday in the world!" she says.

questions.q: Whose birthday is it?
What does Estrella play?
What does Estrella say about Sol's singing?
opts: He sings better than a cat

sentences.es: Cuando Sol era pequeño, era muy tímido.
sentences.en: When Sol was little, he was very shy.

sentences.es: No hablaba mucho porque tenía miedo.
sentences.en: He didn't talk much because he was scared.

sentences.es: Todos los días, miraba el mar desde el cielo.
sentences.en: Every day, he looked at the sea from the sky.

sentences.es: Un día, una estrella le dijo: —¡Hola! ¿Quieres jugar?
sentences.en: One day, a star said to him: "Hello! Do you want to play?"

sentences.es: Sol estaba nervioso, pero dijo que sí.
sentences.en: Sol was nervous, but he said yes.

sentences.es: Jugaron toda la noche y se rieron mucho.
sentences.en: They played all night and laughed a lot.

sentences.es: Por eso, ahora Sol es valiente y tiene muchos amigos.
sentences.en: That's why Sol is brave now and has lots of friends.

sentences.es: —Tienes razón —dice Luna—. ¡La amistad es lo mejor!
sentences.en: "You're right," says Luna. "Friendship is the best!"

questions.q: What was Sol like when he was little?
Who asked Sol to play?
What is Sol like now?

sentences.es: Es sábado por la mañana. Mamá dice: —¡Hoy limpiamos la casa!
sentences.en: It's Saturday morning. Mum says: "Today we're cleaning the house!"

sentences.es: Pablo hace la cama y ordena su dormitorio.
sentences.en: Pablo makes his bed and tidies his bedroom.

sentences.es: Su hermana pone la mesa y su papá lava los platos.
sentences.en: His sister sets the table and his dad washes the dishes.

sentences.es: El perro también ayuda… ¡pero coge un calcetín y corre!
sentences.en: The dog helps too… but he grabs a sock and runs!

sentences.es: Después, mamá le da cinco euros a Pablo.
sentences.en: Afterwards, Mum gives Pablo five euros.

sentences.es: —¡Gracias, mamá! Voy a comprar un libro —dice Pablo.
sentences.en: "Thank you, Mum! I'm going to buy a book," says Pablo.

sentences.es: La casa está limpia y todos están contentos.
sentences.en: The house is clean and everyone is happy.

questions.q: What does Pablo do?
opts: Makes his bed and tidies his room

questions.q: What does the dog grab?
How much money does Mum give Pablo?

sentences.es: Después del cole, Luna y Sol van al patio.
sentences.en: After school, Luna and Sol go to the playground.

sentences.es: Luna sube al tobogán y baja muy rápido.
sentences.en: Luna climbs up the slide and comes down really fast.

sentences.es: Sol prefiere el columpio. ¡Sube muy alto!
sentences.en: Sol prefers the swing. He goes really high!

sentences.es: Luego juegan al escondite. Sol se esconde detrás de un árbol.
sentences.en: Then they play hide and seek. Sol hides behind a tree.

sentences.es: Luna cuenta hasta diez y lo busca. —¡Te encontré! —dice.
sentences.en: Luna counts to ten and looks for him. "Found you!" she says.

sentences.es: En casa, construyen una casa con bloques.
sentences.en: At home, they build a house with blocks.

sentences.es: Por la noche, ven una película muy divertida.
sentences.en: In the evening, they watch a really funny film.

sentences.es: —¡Qué tarde tan divertida! —dice Luna.
sentences.en: "What a fun afternoon!" says Luna.

questions.q: Where do they go after school?
Where does Sol hide?
What do they build at home?

sentences.es: En primavera, hay flores y mariposas en el jardín.
sentences.en: In spring, there are flowers and butterflies in the garden.

sentences.es: En verano, hace mucho calor. Luna nada en el mar con los delfines.
sentences.en: In summer, it's very hot. Luna swims in the sea with the dolphins.

sentences.es: En otoño, las hojas caen de los árboles. Son rojas, naranjas y amarillas.
sentences.en: In autumn, the leaves fall from the trees. They are red, orange and yellow.

sentences.es: En invierno, hace frío y hay nieve en las montañas.
sentences.en: In winter, it's cold and there's snow in the mountains.

sentences.es: Por la noche, Luna mira el cielo y ve las estrellas.
sentences.en: At night, Luna looks at the sky and sees the stars.

sentences.es: —Mi estación favorita es el verano —dice Sol.
sentences.en: "My favourite season is summer," says Sol.

sentences.es: —Pues la mía es el invierno —dice Luna—. ¡Las noches son más largas!
sentences.en: "Well, mine is winter," says Luna. "The nights are longer!"

questions.q: What is in the garden in spring?
Who does Luna swim with in summer?
Why does Luna like winter best?

sentences.es: Mi prima se llama Sara y tiene diez años.
sentences.en: My cousin is called Sara and she's ten years old.

sentences.es: Tiene el pelo largo y rubio, y lleva gafas.
sentences.en: She has long blonde hair, and she wears glasses.

sentences.es: Sara es muy simpática y un poco graciosa.
sentences.en: Sara is very friendly and a bit funny.

sentences.es: Le encantan las matemáticas, pero no le gusta la educación física.
sentences.en: She loves maths, but she doesn't like PE.

sentences.es: Vive en un piso con sus padres, en el tercer piso.
sentences.en: She lives in a flat with her parents, on the third floor.

sentences.es: Su vecino tiene un perro grande y muy amable.
sentences.en: Her neighbour has a big, very friendly dog.

sentences.es: El sábado hay una fiesta en su casa y nos disfrazamos de superhéroes.
sentences.en: On Saturday there's a party at her house and we dress up as superheroes.

sentences.es: ¡Me encanta estar con mi prima!
sentences.en: I love being with my cousin!

questions.q: How old is Sara?
What does Sara love at school?
What do they dress up as at the party?

sentences.es: Hoy la familia de Lucía visita Madrid. Hace buen tiempo.
sentences.en: Today Lucía's family is visiting Madrid. The weather is nice.

sentences.es: Primero, van de compras. Lucía quiere un vestido azul.
sentences.en: First, they go shopping. Lucía wants a blue dress.

sentences.es: —¿Puedo probar la talla mediana? —pregunta Lucía.
sentences.en: "Can I try the medium size?" asks Lucía.

sentences.es: ¡Le queda perfecto! Está de rebajas y cuesta veinte euros.
sentences.en: It fits perfectly! It's on sale and it costs twenty euros.

sentences.es: A las dos, comen en un restaurante.
sentences.en: At two o'clock, they eat at a restaurant.

sentences.es: De primero, ensalada; de segundo, pollo; y de postre, helado.
sentences.en: To start, salad; for the main course, chicken; and for dessert, ice cream.

sentences.es: Papá dice: —La cuenta, por favor.
sentences.en: Dad says: "The bill, please."

sentences.es: Por la tarde, pasean por el parque del Retiro.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, they walk in the Retiro park.

sentences.es: —¡Qué día tan bonito! ¡Hasta luego, Madrid! —dice Lucía.
sentences.en: "What a lovely day! See you later, Madrid!" says Lucía.

questions.q: What does Lucía want to buy?
How much does it cost?
What do they have for dessert?

sentences.es: Hoy Luna se ha despertado muy temprano.
sentences.en: Today Luna woke up very early.

sentences.es: Se ha duchado, se ha vestido y ha desayunado con su familia.
sentences.en: She had a shower, got dressed and had breakfast with her family.

sentences.es: En el cole, ha aprobado el examen de inglés.
sentences.en: At school, she passed the English exam.

sentences.es: —¡Enhorabuena! —le ha dicho la profe.
sentences.en: "Congratulations!" the teacher said to her.

sentences.es: Por la tarde, ha jugado al fútbol con Sol y han ganado el partido.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, she played football with Sol and they won the match.

sentences.es: Después, ha llovido un poco, pero no pasa nada.
sentences.en: Afterwards it rained a little, but that's OK.

sentences.es: Por la noche, Mamá le pregunta: —¿Qué tal te ha ido el día?
sentences.en: At night, Mum asks her: "How did your day go?"

sentences.es: —¡Muy bien! Me lo he pasado genial —dice Luna.
sentences.en: "Really well! I've had a great time," says Luna.

questions.q: Which exam did Luna pass?
Who did Luna play football with?
How was Luna's day?

title: El fin de semana de Sol

sentences.es: El sábado pasado, Sol se levantó muy temprano.
sentences.en: Last Saturday, Sol got up very early.

sentences.es: Desayunó con su familia y después salieron hacia la playa.
sentences.en: He had breakfast with his family and then they set off for the beach.

sentences.es: Llegaron a las diez de la mañana.
sentences.en: They arrived at ten in the morning.

sentences.es: Sol se bañó en el mar y construyó un castillo de arena.
sentences.en: Sol went for a swim in the sea and built a sandcastle.

sentences.es: Su padre tomó el sol debajo de la sombrilla.
sentences.en: His dad sunbathed under the beach umbrella.

sentences.es: A las dos, comieron bocadillos y bebieron zumo de naranja.
sentences.en: At two, they ate sandwiches and drank orange juice.

sentences.es: Por la tarde, jugaron al voleibol y Sol ganó.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, they played volleyball and Sol won.

sentences.es: Al final, volvieron a casa muy cansados, pero muy contentos.
sentences.en: In the end, they went home very tired, but very happy.

questions.q: What time did they arrive at the beach?
What did they eat at two o'clock?
Who won at volleyball?
